info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Knowledge Asset By Param1-spec
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Management API allows businesses to efficiently modify knowledge assets within the banking sector. Through this endpoint, users can update specific details of a knowledge asset identified by 'param1'. This is particularly useful for organizations needing to keep their management manuals current and aligned with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers of this API include bank compliance teams and knowledge management professionals who require up-to-date resources for training and operational support.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of the specified management manual identified by its unique resource ID. Use this operation to modify any relevant information associated with the management manual.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific attributes of the knowledge asset management manual identified by the resource ID RES-100045. The data provided will overwrite existing fields within the management manual.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
